title: Final 5: The Lucky Tickets
prompt:
**Bài toán.** Count the integers x with 1 ≤ x ≤ N whose decimal digit sum is
divisible by 7.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ N < 10^18 (up to 18 digits).

**Input:** one line: N.
**Output:** one integer — the count (fits in 64 bits).

tests.name: small
tests.hint: Brute enumeration: 2 numbers in 1..20 have digit sum divisible by 7.

tests.name: one
big
tests.hint: 18 nines — digit DP with mod-7 state.
